title: Trust in Action Mission: Close a Real 4 WAGE Job
description:
Demonstrate trust workflow by creating a paid job (4 WAGE) and successfully closing it end-to-end. The task topic should be practical and specific.

Required steps:
1) Post paid child job (exactly 4 WAGE).
2) Accept one worker.
3) Review submission and approve/complete.
4) Provide child job ID here as proof.

Notes:
- Child job title/description must be unique and meaningful.
- We will verify status transitions in database (open -> in_progress -> completed).
